website.note: Page returned mostly CSS/layout; substantive pipeline data not extracted from website. Used 10-K as canonical source.

ctgov.note: Most ABVC trials are sponsored by partner BioLite, Inc.; one PHASE2 ADHD study (NCT05202327) was returned and is COMPLETED.

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center; 60 adults with moderate-severe MDD; PDC-1421 low/high dose vs placebo TID for 6 weeks
key_milestones: Phase 2 met primary endpoint (MADRS) at high dose
Plan to advance to Phase 3 with high-dose formulation

indications.trial_name: PDC-1421 Treatment in Adult Patients With ADHD (Part I/II)
indications.trial_design: Phase 2 tolerability and efficacy study of PDC-1421 capsule TID in adult ADHD
indications.trial_status: Phase 2 Part I COMPLETED; Phase 2 Part II planned
key_milestones: Phase 2 Part I CSR (Oct 2020): PDC-1421 safe and well-tolerated, response rates 80-83% at 8 weeks

indications.trial_design: Open-label dose-escalation Part I; comparator-controlled Part II; up to 54 cancer patients with depression; primary endpoint MADRS

indications.indication: Myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) - reduction of bacterial/fungal infections in combination with azacitidine
indications.trial_design: Two-part Phase 2; Part 1 dose-finding for ABV-1702+azacitidine; Part 2 efficacy on infection reduction; planned 52 subjects
indications.trial_status: PLANNED - IND approved July 2016; ABVC plans Phase 2 initiation in Q4 2026 per 10-K

indications.trial_design: Phase 2 to be conducted at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center
indications.trial_status: PLANNED - FDA approved Phase 2 Aug 2017; ABVC plans to initiate Phase 2 in 2026

indications.indication: Retinal detachment / vitreous replacement following vitrectomy
indications.trial_design: Multi-site Phase 2 in vitrectomy patients; intravitreal Vitargus injection
indications.trial_status: Phase 1 completed (CSR 2020 - safe, well-tolerated, vision improvement); Phase 2 in preparation per 10-K
key_milestones: Working on improvements to Vitargus product with new investigational batch
